outlet: Studies of Transition States and Societies 10(1), 3-14
definition: No PG definition. Megaproject = 'very large infrastructure investments... more than US$1 billion' (p. 3).
stakeholders: Political elites decide & legitimate via discourse; civil society opposes. Regime type (democratic alternation vs authoritarian continuity) resolves.
temporality_detail: 'power has changed hands repeatedly in Italy, while Tajikistan has had the same president since 1993... continuity has supported greater progress on the Rogun Dam than the SoMB' (p. 8).
misalignment_detail: Electoral alternation vs continuity determines megaproject fate - via ideology/symbolism, not governance mechanics.
gaps: Demonstrates electoral alternation effect but through ideology, not governance machinery.
key_quotes: Megaproject = 'very large infrastructure investments... more than US$1 billion' (p. 3).
